title: Kernel Panic
description:
When the grid goes down, the real hackers emerge. Kernel Panic is where we disconnect from the mainstream and create our own power grid. Join us for a night that runs entirely off-grid - no corporate overlords, no cloud dependencies, just pure, unadulterated tech culture running on its own infrastructure.

Featuring live performances by nerdcore legends YTcracker and Dual Core - because when you're off the grid, you need beats that can survive without a network connection. These artists know how to generate their own power.

The Setup:

  • Open bar & proper food (sustainably sourced, grid-independent)
  • Networking that operates on peer-to-peer protocols, no central server required
  • Live music that runs on pure energy, no external dependencies

This isn't your typical plugged-in tech event. This is where we prove that the best connections happen when you're completely disconnected. When the infrastructure fails, we build our own.

Quick heads up: Word in the field is there's a surprise belt event happening. That's all we can say for now - some things are better discovered off-grid.
